notes: Ratio is median of reference/candidate ratios for matching pairs; >1 favors candidate. Range and raw wins are descriptive, not significance tests. No overall percentage combines unrelated methods.
All case/cohort entries use six significant digits here; full unrounded observations and fingerprints remain outside Git. CSV observations retain their own explicit precision.
Sampled RSS/workspace/physical+logical process-I/O and20ms role memory are observational lower bounds; RSS may double-count shared pages. Largest waited process RSS is not aggregate memory.

API/worker cgroup CPU/I/O and sampled memory have separate scope. PG CPU/I/O covers helper endpoints including setup; memory.current is endpoint and memory.peak is container-lifetime high-water or null. Do not sum whole-helper and role CPU twice.

HLS phase excludes prefill; total outer wall/network includes prefill. Both measured-phase paired ratios and outer ratios are retained. HLS transport is controlled fixtureHTTPS, not public platform/network.

Server primary is actual HTTP accepted burst through all artifact bytes, with 250 ms polling; outer CPU/wall/resources include setup/cleanup. Baseline queue clock is elapsed-subtraction estimate; candidate observed-log clock includes pipe delay. Composite media_processing includes verification.

Mixed uses independent Stores in one process and a 250 ms controlled transport, with 500 ms completion polling; three baseline references are unpaired, five candidate P0/P1 pairs are matched. P1 remains opt-in.

The prior v4 P1 native/tool120s stall and v6 baseline HLS native FFmpeg stall remain unresolved. Twelve diagnostics or a later passing cohort do not establish a fix. V6 observed approximately170s after an observer trace attachment, so it is failure evidence rather than an uninstrumented speed observation. All v6 timings, including completed cases and pure rows, are excluded. Generation7 ended with a disk preflight setup failure; all its timing is also excluded. This is a separate one-attempt production5.1.9 toolchain cohort with identical original corpus, pairs and oracles; no replacement samples or continuation. Native master stalls are not claimed fixed.
Pure 20 rows are two benchmarks, five alternating pairs each; each row is a median of five 100 ms Go benchmark samples with CPU1. They are separate from media operation/file counts.

Separate unwrapped control uses direct tools instead of counting shells. Its invocation counts are unobserved, never zero. Later-cohort absolute differences do not isolate a per-launch causal cost or mixed Go-wrapper overhead.
No competitor, browser, internet-SLA, long-recording generality, hardware-accelerator or production-deployment claim.
